HTML tag names are case-insensitive: an uppercase void element must not swallow the content that follows it

```python title="Python"
from html_to_markdown import convert

def main() -> None:
    html = '<html><head><META HTTP-EQUIV="Content-Type" CONTENT="text/html; charset=us-ascii"></head><body><p>Signature placeholder</p></body></html>'
    result = convert(html)
    print(result.content)

main()
```
